# HermesSub

> HermesSub is a free real-time game subtitle translator and multi-character AI voice dubbing application for Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon), PlayStation 5 (no jailbreak required), and Smart TVs (LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Android TV), with an upcoming iOS/iPadOS companion.

## Core Capabilities

- **Context-Aware Story Translation:** Tracks ongoing game narrative, character relationships, speaker tone (e.g., Vietnamese honorifics and pronoun pairs), and game-specific glossaries instead of translating isolated OCR lines out of context.
- **Multi-Character AI Voice Acting:** Assigns distinct voices to individual speakers (protagonists, companions, antagonists) using local offline voices (Piper, Windows/Apple system voices) or online TTS engines.
- **Zero-Jailbreak PlayStation 5 & 0ms Smart TV Overlay:** Keeps the player's DualSense controller on the primary PSN account over native HDMI (0ms input latency) while HermesSub reads dialogue silently via a secondary PSN Remote Play session or chiaki-ng/HDMI capture card, pushing crisp cinema subtitles directly onto LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, or Android TV.
- **Privacy & Local-First Architecture:** No account required, no advertisements, and no third-party ad trackers. Screen OCR runs locally on the user's device, and optional Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) AI keys (Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenAI) are encrypted locally via Windows DPAPI or Apple Keychain.

## Official Downloads (Free)

- [Windows x64 Release (v1.0.4)](https://github.com/HermesSub/hermessub.github.io/releases/download/v1.0.4/HermesSub-win-x64.zip): Standalone desktop package for Windows 10/11.
- [macOS Apple Silicon Release (v1.0.4)](https://github.com/HermesSub/hermessub.github.io/releases/download/v1.0.4/HermesSub-osx-arm64.zip): Native desktop package for M1/M2/M3/M4 Macs.
- [GitHub Releases Hub](https://github.com/HermesSub/hermessub.github.io/releases): Changelog, release binaries, and community game dictionaries.

- [PS5, chiaki-ng & Smart TV Setup Guides (EN)](https://hermessub.com/en/guides/): Step-by-step walkthroughs for first-time PS5 Remote Play pairing, chiaki-ng setup, and daily 0ms Smart TV play.
- [Chính sách Quyền riêng tư (VI)](https://hermessub.com/privacy/): Chi tiết xử lý dữ liệu tại máy và cam kết bảo mật.
